summary.text: James Maroney, a Democrat from Milford, was first elected in 2018 to represent the 14th Senate District and is Deputy Majority Leader and co-chair of the General Law Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before politics he founded and ran an educational consulting business in Milford and served on the Milford Board of Education.
He graduated from Jonathan Law High School in 1992 and from Yale in the class of 1996.
